_comment: Vendor CAD files used to render part sprites (see README.md). 'axes' gives the CAD axis for the part's x (out of the optic's front face), y (your right when facing the optic) and z (up); 'origin_mm' is the CAD point that becomes the part origin (on the optic axis above the mounting tap). Files themselves are not committed.

KM100CP._note: metric KM100CP/M file: identical body, M4 instead of 8-32 taps
